_description: Grandfathered web UI invariant violations, seeded at the start of the frontend redesign. New violations fail CI. This list only ever shrinks, every redesign phase should reduce it, and the redesign is not finished while it is non-empty. Do not add to it.

_reasons.raw-palette: Seeded at the start of the frontend redesign: a literal Tailwind palette class where a semantic token belongs. Each one is owed a token; the count only falls.
_reasons.raw-bw: Seeded at the start of the frontend redesign: bg-white or text-black assumes light mode is the only theme. Owed a background/foreground token.
_reasons.arbitrary-color: Seeded at the start of the frontend redesign: a literal colour in an arbitrary-value class. Owed a token in the theme layer.
_reasons.opacity-diluted-text: Seeded at the start of the frontend redesign: a foreground token diluted with an opacity modifier, which drops it under 4.5:1. Owed a size or weight change instead.
_reasons.tiny-type-css: Seeded at the start of the frontend redesign: a stylesheet declaration below the 12px legibility floor, mostly in the legacy marketing CSS. Owed a role token.
_reasons.hover-only-affordance: Seeded at the start of the frontend redesign: an affordance revealed only on hover, unreachable on touch. Owed a permanent low-emphasis state.
_reasons.arbitrary-z-index: Rung measured on 2026-09-20 when the rule was added: a bare Tailwind z-[n] outside the overlay/modal/popover ladder, so two layers can outrank each other by accident. Owed a token rung.
_reasons.arbitrary-z-index-css: Rung measured on 2026-09-20 when the rule was added: a bare z-index in a stylesheet, almost all of it the legacy marketing CSS. Owed a token rung.
_reasons.outline-none-without-focus-ring: Measured on 2026-09-20 when the rule was added: outline-none with no focus-visible replacement within the element, so a keyboard user loses the caret. Owed a focus ring, tracked as an accessibility defect not a style preference.
_reasons.unsafe-blank-target: Measured on 2026-09-20 when the rule was added: target=_blank with no rel=noopener, which hands window.opener to the destination. Owed rel="noopener noreferrer" on each anchor.
_reasons.clickable-div-without-semantics: Measured on 2026-09-20 when the rule was added: onClick on a div, span, li or td with no role and no tabIndex, so the control does not exist for the keyboard. Owed a button or a role plus key handler.
